sources.title: zurichquants/GLM-5.3-Flash · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash starts from a newly trained base model, with its architecture and training recipe redesigned around capability and efficiency. For the first time in the GLM series, we introduce a hybrid architecture combining sparse and linear attention, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context capabilities.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: Frontier Intelligence, Flash Cost - z.ai
sources.snippet: Before release, we tested GLM-5.3-Flash anonymously as ox-alpha on OpenCode and OpenRouter to gather user feedback. It quickly became the most popular model of the week — with all of this traffic served on Chinese AI chips.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. It is a 320B Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters, built for coding, agentic work, and visual tasks, and released under the MIT License.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash by Z.ai | Model Library | Modal
sources.snippet: Model GLM-5.3-Flash pairs sparse attention with linear attention in a hybrid architecture that reduces attention computation and KV-cache size. Trained on a multimodal corpus, it integrates visual understanding directly into coding and agentic workflows. Full details are in Z.ai's announcement.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: Model Overview GLM-5.3-Flash is the first native multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, delivering stronger intelligence than GLM-5.2 at an exceptionally low cost. Highly Efficient Hybrid Architecture GLM-5.3-Flash has 320B total parameters with 18B activated.
